meta.title: BrokerVerse | Insurance Broker Management Platform
meta.description: Run client, placement, policy, renewal, claims support, commission and brokerage operations in one insurance-first platform.

hero.title: The operating platform for modern insurance brokers.
hero.lede: Bring clients, insurers, placements, policies, renewals, claims support, commissions, financial activity and documentation into one insurance-first workspace.

problem.title: A broker platform should understand the business behind the relationship.
body: A brokerage sits between customers, insurers and service providers while managing policy, placement, servicing and financial complexity. Generic CRM tools rarely understand that operating model.
BrokerVerse is designed around brokerage work itself.

journey.title: Win. Place. Service. Renew. Reconcile.
journey.body: Manage prospects, clients and opportunities. Coordinate requirements, carrier responses and placement. Manage policy and customer activity. Turn expiries into assigned work. Connect policy activity with premiums and commissions.

builtFor.title: One platform, six kinds of brokerage work.

items.description: Clients, opportunities, placement and servicing.
Carrier relationships, quotations and placement workflows.
Policies, endorsements, documents and renewals.
Premiums, commissions, receipts and reconciliation.
Portfolio, revenue and operational visibility.
Roles, access and controls.

intelligence.title: See the whole book, not one account at a time.
intelligence.body: Client portfolio, policy portfolio, renewal pipeline, carrier relationships, premiums, commissions, claims support, operational workload and management reporting, brought into a single operating view.

integration.title: Connect the carrier and enterprise systems around the brokerage.
integration.body: Integration can be designed around carrier, policy, finance and other enterprise systems as required.

items.description: Better visibility across clients, renewals, carrier relationships and revenue-related activity.
More structured placement, servicing and renewal work.
Clearer links between policy activity, premiums and commissions where configured.
An insurance-first operating layer that can connect with carrier and enterprise systems.

proof.title: Evidence, close to the claim.
proof.body: A brokerage, API or intermediary-transformation engagement demonstrating reduced operating friction or faster connectivity is the most relevant evidence for this product.
proof.pendingNote: Publish only the customer name and metric set cleared for public use.

items.question: Is BrokerVerse only for large brokers?
items.answer: No. It can support growing brokerages as well as multi-branch and more complex brokerage operating models.

items.question: Can it manage commissions?
items.answer: Commission calculation and finance-related brokerage workflows are part of the broader BrokerVerse operating model where configured.

items.question: Can BrokerVerse connect to insurer systems?
items.answer: Yes. Integration can be designed around carrier, policy, finance and other enterprise systems as required.

cta.title: Run more of the brokerage from one insurance-first workspace.

meta.title: BrokerVerse Features | Client, Policy, Placement & Commission Operations
meta.description: Explore BrokerVerse capabilities for client management, placement, policies, renewals, claims support, premiums, commissions, finance, documents and broker controls.

hero.title: Run the business behind the broker relationship.
hero.lede: BrokerVerse is designed around brokerage operations rather than generic contact management. It brings client, insurer, policy, placement, service, renewal, claims-support and financial activity into a more structured broker operating environment.

features.note: Exact finance, accounting, carrier-connectivity and line-of-business modules should be confirmed against the deployed product scope.

items.description: Maintain personal or business client information in an insurance-oriented structure.
Record the people associated with an account and their roles.
Retain activities, communication and key account information.
See policies and relevant service activity connected to the customer.
Track potential new business before placement begins.
Maintain responsibility across brokers, account executives or teams.
Track structured client work rather than relying on email alone.

groups.title: Move opportunities into broker operations without losing context.

items.description: Track potential business before it becomes a placement.
Represent how commercial conversations actually progress.
Record the work required to move an account forward.
Keep client contact planned rather than reactive.
Give each item of client work an owner.
Understand what is in progress across the brokerage.
Bridge commercial activity and the operational work required to place and service insurance.

groups.title: Keep placement activity organized across client and carrier.

items.description: Record the client's insurance requirement and supporting information.
Prepare or track requests sent to insurers where the implementation supports that workflow.
Record quotations, terms or responses received from insurers.
Organize available carrier options for broker review.
Track progress from requirement through insurer selection and binding steps appropriate to the operating model.
Make it clear which carrier or internal team is waiting on the next action.
Keep supporting documents connected to the account and transaction.

groups.title: Keep the policy relationship active after placement.

items.description: Maintain the brokerage-side policy record with coverage and key policy information.
Connect each policy to the carrier that issued it.
Track changes across the policy term.
Record policy cancellation where supported.
Keep schedules, certificates and correspondence with the record.
Turn client requests into tracked work with an owner.
The insurer's policy administration system remains the source of truth where the integration architecture defines it that way.
Surface policies approaching expiry.
Assign renewal ownership.
Track discussions, requirements and follow-up.
Coordinate remarketing or renewal quotation activity.
Keep relevant renewal information together.
Understand which accounts are pending, quoted, renewed, lost or require escalation.
Give leaders a forward view of renewal workload and potential retention risk.

groups.title: Keep the broker informed when the customer needs help most.

items.description: Record what the client has reported and when.
Connect the claim to the placed policy.
Track what the client has been told and what they still need.
Record the broker's follow-up with the carrier or service provider.
Keep claim evidence attached to the account.
Track where the claim sits without reconstructing it from email.
This supports brokerage-side claims servicing and advocacy. Formal insurer claim adjudication belongs in the carrier claims environment or ClaimVerse where configured.

groups.title: Connect policy activity with broker revenue.

items.description: Maintain premium values associated with placed business.
Calculate or record expected commissions according to configured rules where supported.
Compare expected and received commission information.
Support configured splits or allocation where available.
Surface outstanding financial items associated with clients or insurers.
Help teams investigate differences between expected and actual values.
All financial calculations and accounting treatment must reflect the implemented product and local financial-control requirements.

groups.title: Reduce the gap between brokerage operations and finance.

items.description: Record money received and paid where the deployed scope supports it.
Maintain financial entries connected to brokerage activity.
Surface what remains unsettled across clients and insurers.
Retain the financial record behind an account.
Connect entries to the underlying financial instruction.
Compare expected and actual financial positions.

groups.title: Keep evidence attached to the work.

items.description: Keep the paperwork with the account it belongs to.
Retain what was requested and what the carrier returned.
Hold claim evidence alongside the policy.
Understand what changed and when, where supported.
Retain executed agreements and confirmations.
Make missing evidence visible before it becomes a problem.

Track what was asked and what came back.

API connectivity where available, structured integration where direct APIs are not. BrokerVerse is not a universal electronic trading network unless the product team confirms that capability.

meta.title: BrokerVerse Use Cases | Retail, SME & Commercial Brokerage
meta.description: See how BrokerVerse supports retail, SME, commercial, renewal, claims-support, premium, commission and multi-branch workflows for insurance brokers.

hero.title: Built for brokerage work, not generic CRM.
hero.lede: BrokerVerse supports the operational relationship between client, broker and insurer across new business, policy service, renewal, claims support and financial administration.

cases.title: Retail brokerage
cases.situation: A broker manages a large number of personal customers across multiple products and insurers. Service requests, renewals and documents generate a high volume of routine work.
cases.usage: Client records, policy portfolios, service activity, renewals, documents and claims-support information are brought into one working environment. Tasks and cases help staff organize work by customer rather than inbox.
cases.change: Faster access to customer context. Better renewal discipline. Less time searching for policy and service information.

cases.title: SME account management
cases.situation: SME clients may hold several policies and need regular changes, renewals and advice, but the brokerage cannot dedicate a large commercial team to every account.
cases.usage: The broker maintains the business account, contacts, policy portfolio, open opportunities, service cases and renewal activity together. Structured tasks help teams manage multiple client requirements efficiently.
cases.change: More consistent account servicing. Better visibility across policies. Reduced dependence on individual staff knowledge.

cases.title: Commercial and complex placement
cases.situation: A commercial requirement may need information from the client, submissions to several insurers, multiple responses, specialist review and extensive documentation.
cases.usage: Requirements, insurer interactions, quote responses, placement status, documents and broker activities are organized around the account and placement process. Carrier connectivity can be added according to the target environment.
cases.change: Better placement control. Clearer status across insurers. Less fragmented documentation and communication.

cases.title: Renewal operations
cases.situation: Upcoming expiries can create operational peaks. Without a structured renewal workbench, valuable accounts may receive late attention.
cases.usage: Renewals are surfaced in advance, assigned to owners and tracked through client engagement, insurer quotation, document collection and outcome.
cases.change: Earlier renewal action. Better retention visibility. More predictable workload. Stronger management oversight.

cases.title: Client servicing and endorsements
cases.situation: Clients need certificates, policy changes, endorsements, documents and status updates throughout the policy term.
cases.usage: Service requests can be recorded as structured cases with ownership, tasks, documents and insurer interaction attached.
cases.change: Less service work hidden in email. Clearer accountability. Better response history.

cases.title: Claims advocacy
cases.situation: Clients often turn to their broker for help after a loss even though the insurer owns claim adjudication.
cases.usage: The broker records claim-related information, tracks communication, follows insurer and provider status and keeps client support activity connected to the policy.
cases.change: Better customer communication. Clearer broker-side follow-up. Less manual reconstruction of claim history.

cases.title: Commission reconciliation
cases.situation: Broker teams need to compare expected commissions with insurer statements or received values and investigate differences.
cases.usage: Policy, premium and commission records can be linked with financial transactions and reconciliation workflows where supported.
cases.change: Improved commission visibility. Faster identification of mismatches. Better finance and operating alignment.

cases.title: Multi-branch brokerage
cases.situation: A brokerage operates across locations or teams with different portfolios but needs common governance and management reporting.
cases.usage: Role, hierarchy, branch, access and workflow structures can represent the organization while client and business data remain controlled according to responsibility.
cases.change: More consistent operating practices. Better enterprise reporting. Clearer access control.

cases.title: Compliance and audit readiness
cases.situation: The brokerage needs evidence of documents, activities, approvals and user actions during internal review or regulatory examination.
cases.usage: Documents, cases, communications, activity history, permissions and audit records are kept closer to the related business transaction.
cases.change: Faster evidence retrieval. Better traceability. Reduced reliance on personal inboxes and shared drives.

cta.title: Run brokerage operations around the client, policy and placement.
